_what_this_is: A placeholder, on purpose and labelled as one everywhere it renders. It is the shape a second reviewer's page takes, so that the person being asked can see exactly what would be published about them before they agree to any of it. Nobody is described here: every field says what would go in it, not what is true of anybody.
name: CISO XYZ

status.note: Not a person and not available. This entry exists so the shape can be read before anybody is asked to fill it in.

one_line: One sentence, in the person's own published words where there are any: the role, the organisation and the thing they are known for.
why_them: Why this reviewer rather than any other, stated as fact rather than praise: the kind of estate they have run, the agents they have had to answer for, the sectors whose questions they already know the shape of.

sources.what: The page they publish about themselves — a company bio, a conference speaker page, a personal site. Every row of the record below is read off it, and this site composes none of it.
A second published source: a talk, a paper, a standard they contributed to, an open-source project. It is what makes the record checkable without trusting us.

record.detail: What it involves, in a sentence, read off the page they publish. If there is no published page there is no row: we do not write a biography for somebody and then charge £1,500 beside it.

record.what: The estate they have answered for
record.detail: Size, sector and the kind of systems — the fact a buyer is actually weighing when they choose one reviewer over another.
A talk, a paper, a tool, a standard. Named, linked and dated, because it is the part of a reviewer's record that can be checked in five minutes.

writing.what: Where they write, if they write
writing.detail: A blog, a newsletter, a conference track. Linked, not summarised.

languages.what: The languages they can run the two sessions in
languages.detail: A session is a conversation, so this is a real difference between reviewers rather than a flag on a page. It is stated only where the person has confirmed it in writing.

interests_declared: What a buyer should know before weighing the review: who employs them, what they sell, which vendors they are involved with. Every reviewer on this list declares theirs, and the declaration sits on the page rather than in a footer.

reach.what: How to reach them, once there is somebody to reach.
